about: Zynaptiq Preset XML version 3 or 4. inputParams count and pN attributes hold scalar values. VST3 component state (verified on PUNCH 1 and UNMIX DRUMS) uses a u32 little-endian XML length including a terminating NUL, then the XML and NUL.

layers: UTF-8 XML Preset; inputParams attributes p0 through p<count-1>; preserve all other elements
u32 LE byte count including NUL; XML Preset; NUL

survey.source: Installed native preset files and shipped parameter-name metadata; no factory preset bodies copied.
survey.verification: Native documents inspected; installed-binary version and runtime acceptance remain unverified.
